definitions.label: Finite metric under unchanged threshold iff working_output_qualified; otherwise unknown.
definitions.six_cells: published/abstained crossed with correct/wrong/unknown; sum equals full fixed scope N.
definitions.undefined_scope: Synthetic BOP scope is undefined. N=0 is only an empty placeholder with defined=false and null rates; it is not a valid zero-error BOP evaluation.
definitions.paired: 2x2 baseline/research availability, each split by same raw candidate label; all cells sum to N.
definitions.pooling: Pool real counts only, matching metric threshold grid indices; ADD uses each object original diameter. Synthetic worlds never pooled as independent streams.

limitations: Exploratory rule motivated by known real development labels; not a blinded or held-out test.
Output-only decision replay on frozen trajectories; no new tracking, point-stream or FP causal improvement claim.
Candidate-based branch arbitration can pass a wrong candidate agreeing with one wrong stream; all trust flags stay false.
The synthetic same-appearance records have no real secondary bridge; unchanged results test regression, not the new conflict rule against impostors.
Stay/exchange labels refer to the same ambiguous input stream and cannot be counted as independent videos.
No threshold tuning, GT-selected frame filtering, symmetry permutation of fixed point correspondences or label-dependent branch selection.
